data.one_liner: Flutter-native updater package for application updates.
data.what_it_does: Handles application updates by checking the latest version, downloading binary updates, optionally unzipping or running installers, and providing built-in UI widgets and dialogs for desktop and mobile.
use_when: You need to provide in-app updates for your desktop or mobile Flutter application.
You want customizable update UI chips and dialogs out of the box.
avoid_when: You rely strictly on official platform app stores (like Google Play or Apple App Store) that manage updates natively.
You do not have a server or hosting provider to serve the binary updates.
strengths: Provides ready-to-use update widgets and dialog themes.
Supports unzipping archives and sending custom HTTP headers for downloads.
weaknesses: Requires managing your own binary hosting and version check endpoints.
Platform-specific update behaviors might require careful configuration depending on the target OS.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and place the UpdatWidget or UpdatWindowManager in your widget tree.
data.minimal_example:
UpdatWidget(
  currentVersion: "1.0.0",
  getLatestVersion: () async => "1.0.1",
  getBinaryUrl: (latestVersion) async => "https://github.com/latest/release/bin.exe",
  appName: "Updat Example",
)
